facts.fact: Brawley 自陈：Vero 每次发作后他要数周才能恢复睡眠
facts.anchor: After every episode Vero experiences, I take weeks to get back into a good sleeping pattern

facts.fact: porch 上 Brawley 惊叹她的到来：他从未想过有人能像我这样爱 Vero
facts.anchor: I’m struck by how lucky we are that she is here, as I never imagined someone could love Vero the way I do

facts.fact: 他终于说出：开棺那一刻他以为她死了
facts.anchor: When we opened the coffin, I thought you were dead

facts.fact: 秒变小时的等待里，他先想的是如何告诉 Vero、会不会毁掉或改变他
facts.anchor: whether telling him would finish him or change him

facts.fact: 他的指节因捶树淤青——Kayla 翻看时他承认那不是最佳时刻
Brawley 的分配逻辑：一人螺旋比两人容易；Kayla 反问「对谁容易」
facts.anchor: It’s easier if it’s just one of us spiraling

facts.fact: Kayla 给出分担公式：你两成我八成，你不再独自扛
facts.anchor: If you are running at twenty percent, tell me and I will function at eighty

facts.fact: 亲密中他低语「我不能失去你」，她以一个吻咽下——她无法承诺不会
facts.anchor: I can’t lose you,” I whisper
